title: Fleet Comeback Wear Deduction — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
**Wear deduction.** On a Service Accounts and Repair Orders commercial fleet account (Commercial Fleet Account - Net 15 or Net 30), the wear deduction on a comeback credit follows the miles between the repairs and the unit's maintenance record in the Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans records.

| Repeat repair's odometer beyond the original repair's odometer | The unit has an active Kessler Care maintenance plan | The credit is reduced by |
|---|---|---|
| More than 8000 miles | No | 0.15 of itself |
| More than 8000 miles | Yes | 0.05 of itself |
| 8000 miles or fewer | Either | nothing; there is no wear deduction |

The unit is the vehicle on the repeat labor charge. The odometers are those recorded at check-in on the repeat labor charge and on the original repair's parts charge.

**Edges (hypothetical).** Original at 21400 miles: a repeat at 29400 is 8000 miles beyond, no deduction; a repeat at 29401 is more than 8000 beyond.
